title: How to get to production faster with Claude Managed Agents
description: Building agents used to mean spending development cycles on secure infrastructure, state management, permissioning, and reworking your agent loops for every model upgrade. Managed Agents, on the Claude Platform, now handles that layer for you. This session covers the fundamentals of building and deploying a production-grade agent at scale and you'll also get to hear from industry leaders on the future of agentic infrastructure.
